title: Create the ADR index
acceptance: docs/adr/README.md lists each ADR file with status and date; node -e "const fs=require('fs');const t=fs.readFileSync('docs/adr/README.md','utf8');process.exit(fs.readdirSync('docs/adr').filter(f=>/^\d{4}-/.test(f)).every(f=>t.includes(f))?0:1)" exits 0
